note: Re-read the whole RFC 9069 section 5.2 fabricated-OPEN sentence, the single-polarity annotation, all three tagged tests and fabricateLocRIBOpen/buildLocRIBUpdateBody. The required-capability test decodes the fabricated BGP OPEN and requires the router's 4200000001 ASN4 capability and the dump's exact family set. The separate capability census requires exactly one ASN4 capability, the exact Multiprotocol list, exactly the one IPv4-unicast/IPv6-next-hop pair and no other capability code. The IPv4-with-IPv6-next-hop test now supplies a complete stored ORIGIN plus valid empty AS_PATH, proves the produced MP_REACH_NLRI uses AFI 1 with a 16-octet next hop, and requires the OPEN's matching Extended Next Hop capability. Thus missing, surplus and representation-incompatible capabilities fail distinct assertions. The single producer's fixed capability declaration is shared with the dump families; no separate nonconformant input is needed for the valid single-polarity annotation.
